violation_type.title: Update Admission Information - Parent Sign and Date (26 TAC §746.609(b))
violation_type.short_title: Update Admission Information - Parent Sign and Date
violation_type.typical_finding: The parent of a child in care was not given the opportunity to review the new admission form the staff had completed on the child and make any needed corrections.  As a result, the child was transported to a school in error and left there based on inaccurate information on the new form.  This would have been prevented if the parent had been able to review the new admission form.

finding_variants.text: The parent of a child in care was not given the opportunity to review the new admission form the staff had completed on the child and make any needed corrections.  As a result, the child was transported to a school in error and left there based on inaccurate information on the new form.  This would have been prevented if the parent had been able to review the new admission form.
One child did not have updated admission paperwork related to a food allergy.  This was corrected at inspection when the staff obtained the updated information from the child's parent and doctor.
Operation did not have a system to update records when children enroll in school.

It was found that a parent updated the child's enrollment record by requesting a person be added as a designated pick up person, but the enrollment record was not physically updated and a signature of the parent was not obtained to verify the update.
Out of the records evaluated for children, one child did not have their admission form signed/dated by the parent.
During review 9 out of 10 children's records reviewed had no updates signed and dated by the parents.
